title: Jammy Gooey Argentinian Dill Pickles Empanadas
description: A sweet and tangy twist on traditional empanadas, featuring a jammy gooey filling of dill pickles and a sweet surprise, inspired by the flavors of Argentina.
instructions: Roll out the empanada dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a tablespoon of dill pickle filling in the center of each dough circle.
Add a few granulated sugar and milk chocolate chips on top of the pickle filling.
Brush the edges of the dough with the egg wash and fold the dough over to form a half-moon shape.
Press the edges together with a fork to seal the empanada.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with the egg wash.
Bake the empanadas in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Let the empanadas cool for a few minutes before serving.
